description: Spreads the notes of a polyphonic chord apart so that no note is closer to the one before it than a set number of semitones

params.text: Sets the smallest gap allowed between one output note and the next, 0 to 12 semitones; where a pair falls short the later note is pushed up an octave
Sets the octave of the lowest note the module will put out, 0 to 8, with 4 putting C at 0V
Sets the pitch class of the lowest note the module will put out, the twelve semitones counting up from C

inputs.text: The chord, as a polyphonic 1V/octave pitch with one note per channel
Only the channels whose gate here is above 0V are taken as part of the chord; with nothing patched every channel of the cv input is used

outputs.text: The spread chord, one channel per sounding note, as 1V/octave pitches

notes: only the pitch class of each incoming note is used; the octave it arrives in is discarded and the module places the notes in octaves of its own.
the display above the knobs reads out the lowest note the oct and note knobs are set to.
menu: Sort input — puts the incoming notes in order from lowest to highest before spreading them

inputs.1:
high above 0V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads every channel of the cv input counts.
